court_name: Superior Court of California, County of Merced
case_search_note: Criminal and traffic case information is NOT available online in Merced — the court's online portal (jpportal.mercedcourt.org) covers only civil and small claims. For criminal cases use the public computer in the Criminal Clerk's Office (Ogletree Jr. Courthouse, 2260 N Street), mail a Record/Search/Copy Request (form MSC-RR-001), or ask a clerk in person. Staff take phone calls for calendar/case info from the defendant or their attorney: Criminal Division (209) 725-4113. $15 search fee if a search takes more than 10 minutes.

legal_aid.name: Merced County Public Defender — Post Disposition Dismissals and Reductions
legal_aid.serves: People with Merced County convictions who finished probation and paid all fines/fees
legal_aid.what: PC 1203.4 dismissals and felony-to-misdemeanor reductions. Stop by either PD office (1944 M St, Merced or 445 I St, Los Banos) to fill out a Relief Information sheet; a Post Conviction Specialist reviews it. The page says neither the PD nor the court charges a fee for expungement. You must have no open cases, not be on probation or serving time.

Legal Advice & Referral Line (800) 675-8001. Pro Bono Program (559) 570-1274, ProBono@CentralCalLegal.org.
legal_aid.note: Office: 1640 N Street, Suite 200, Merced, CA 95340. Los Banos satellite listed.

programs.name: Probation Pretrial Services Unit
programs.summary: Probation staff do pretrial assessments using the Public Safety Assessment (PSA) and supervise people on pretrial release according to risk level. Defendants download the Supervision Access app for court reminders; people without a smartphone are given one at no cost. The unit writes reports to help the court decide release.

jails.name: Merced County Main Jail
jails.phone_note: Visits: sign in at the lobby window starting the hour before the visit (by 15 min before); two visitors per visiting day; approved visitor list required. Schedule in the 'Main Jail Visitation Schedule' PDF. The 2025/2026 Grand Jury says Main Jail inmates will be moved to the new JLCC expansion (scheduled 2027).
jails.court_ids_note: Nearest criminal courthouse (about a block away), not confirmed by the Sheriff. Los Banos (los-banos) also hears criminal cases.
jails.todo: Sheriff page doesn't say men/women; 2025/2026 Grand Jury says it holds low- to high-risk inmates (capacity 189) without stating sex

jails.name: John Latorraca Correctional Center (JLCC)
jails.phone_note: Same visiting rules as Main Jail; see 'JLCC Visitation Schedule' PDF. Capacity 564 (Grand Jury, Oct 2025); expansion under construction. Grand Jury report lists the address as 2840 W. Sandy Mush Road; the county directory says 2584.

bail.note: Before paying a bail agent, check that their license is active with the California Department of Insurance license lookup. The court's fee & bail schedules are at https://www.merced.courts.ca.gov/forms-filing/fee-bail-schedules. To find someone in custody use the county's 'Inmate and Booking Information' search linked from the Sheriff's Jail Information page. Money for an inmate: TouchPay (site ID 295340), 1-866-232-1899 or tponlinepay.com, or the Main Jail lobby kiosk. This is information only, not legal advice.
